# Sample requirements.txt for parser testing.
#
# Deliberately includes:
#   - Pinned exact versions:           package==version
#   - Range constraints:               package>=version,<version
#   - Compatible release:              package~=version
#   - Extras:                          package[extra]==version
#   - No version (unpinned):           package
#   - Environment markers:             package==version ; python_version >= "3.8"
#   - Inline comments:                 package==version  # some note
#   - Line continuations:              package==version \
#                                          --hash=sha256:abc
#   - Options/flags (must be skipped): -r base.txt, --index-url, -e git+...
#   - URL requirements (skipped):      https://example.com/package.whl
#
# Known-vulnerable packages for CVE matching validation:
#   - Pillow 9.1.0       → CVE-2022-22817 (arbitrary code execution)
#   - PyYAML 5.3.1       → CVE-2020-14343 (arbitrary code execution)
#   - Django 2.2.0       → CVE-2019-14234 (SQL injection)
#   - cryptography 3.4.6 → CVE-2023-23931 (memory corruption)
#   - urllib3 1.26.4     → CVE-2021-33503 (ReDoS)

# ---- Options and flags (parser must skip these) ----
--index-url https://pypi.org/simple/
--extra-index-url https://private.example.com/simple/
-r base.txt
-c constraints.txt

# ---- URL requirement (parser must skip) ----
https://example.com/some_package-1.0-py3-none-any.whl

# ---- Editable install (parser must skip) ----
-e git+https://github.com/example/repo.git@main#egg=mypackage
